# Class: `SampleCatalogTreeModel`

Maps sample IDs and schema fields into an editable two-column Qt model.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-sample-catalog.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_sample_catalog.py#L66) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QAbstractItemModel`.

Use `setData` through the model’s editing route to preserve validation, shared-field propagation, and history. A field can remain visible while irrelevant to a sample type.
